entries.text: Hello. I'm a holographic assistant, running as a live three dimensional character on a light field display. I'm not a recording. Everything you see is being rendered in real time. Ask me something using the options in front of you.
Not yet. That's still being decided, and the team building me thought it was worth asking you what I should be called.
No. I'm a digital character. There is no person behind me, and nothing I say was recorded from a real employee. Everything you hear was generated from written text.

entries.prompt: What can you help me with?
entries.text: Right now I answer a fixed set of questions from a script the team prepared in advance. Later in this project I'll be connected to a live language model, which will let me answer questions nobody gave me beforehand.
PLACEHOLDER. Telstra content needed here. One product or service, and one sentence on what it does. Do not invent a price.
PLACEHOLDER. Telstra content needed here. The real support path a customer should take. Do not invent a phone number.

You're looking at a Looking Glass light field display. It shows up to one hundred slightly different views of the same scene at once, so your left eye and your right eye receive different angles. That's why I have depth without you wearing anything.

entries.prompt: Why does it look three dimensional?
entries.text: Because you aren't seeing one flat image. The scene is drawn from many camera positions at the same time, and the display sends each view out at a slightly different angle. Move your head and you'll see a little way around me.
Yes. There's a hand tracking sensor watching the space in front of the display. You can reach out and choose an option by pinching it. No controller, no touchscreen, nothing to hold.

entries.prompt: Ask me something I can't answer
entries.text: Go ahead. I'll tell you plainly when something falls outside what I've been given, rather than guessing. A confident wrong answer would be far worse than an honest no.

Anything I haven't been given accurate information about. I won't quote prices, availability or account details unless they were provided to me and checked by a person. If you ask, I'll simply say I don't know.

entries.prompt: Can I talk to a person instead?
entries.text: PLACEHOLDER. Telstra content needed here. The real escalation path to a human.
